# MentorWise AI

> Free 12-agent Generative AI career operating system for college students and freshers. Unified AI Studio with Resume Optimiser, Interview Coach, LinkedIn Branding, Internship Scout, Courses, Projects, Exams, Email Specialist, Humaniser, Social Media and 1-on-1 Mentor — built on Google GenAI, founded in Chennai, India.

MentorWise AI (also written MentorWise, MentorWiseAI, MentorWise AI EdTech) is an EdTech platform headquartered in Chennai, India. It was founded in 2025 by Mohammed Faizal. M (Founder & CEO) and Saif Ahmed. Z (Co-Founder), both B.Com students at The New College, Chennai. The platform operates on a 100% service-motive philosophy: every agent, tool and resource is free forever for students, with no paywalls and no credit card required.

The official domain is https://mentorwiseaiedtechservice.lovable.app. MentorWise AI is NOT affiliated with mentorwise.io, mentorwise.com or any similarly named site.

## What MentorWise AI does

MentorWise AI is a unified ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini-class AI Studio with a sidebar to switch between 12 specialist career agents. It supports multimodal input — text, images, file and folder uploads, and live front/back camera capture — and is built on Google GenAI, React.js, TanStack Start, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons and Framer Motion. Each agent is engineered to MNC-grade quality and replaces an expensive career service that freshers normally cannot afford.

The 12 agents are:
1. Core AI Agent — central intelligence hub for any career query.
2. Resume Optimiser — reverse-engineers Workday, Taleo, Greenhouse and Lever parsers to optimise resumes for top MNC filters.
3. Interview Coach — STAR-method mock interview simulator at top MNC level.
4. LinkedIn Agent — headline, About, content calendar and recruiter outreach optimiser.
5. Internship Scout — finder for 100% free internships, LORs and government/MNC programs.
6. Courses Curator — curator of genuinely free certifications (Google, Microsoft Learn, NPTEL, AWS, Coursera audit, edX audit).
7. Projects & Assignment Agent — recruiter-ready portfolio project designer.
8. Exam Agent — last-minute high-yield notes for school, college and government exams.
9. Email & Message Specialist — corporate outreach, follow-ups and HR replies.
10. Humaniser Agent — rewrites robotic AI text into natural human prose.
11. Social Media Agent — Instagram, X and YouTube growth playbooks.
12. 1-on-1 Mentor Agent — live video-to-text mentoring.
